items.title: Pay invoice for leaf removal and gutter cleaning
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung.
items.computation: This is a private service invoice (not from an authority), so the statutory delivery fiction for administrative letters does not apply; instead the ordinary rule is that the payment period runs from the day after actual receipt of the invoice (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), counted for 10 days, with the last day moved to the next business day if it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (§ 193 BGB). However, the invoice carries no printed date and no proof of the date the recipient actually received it, so the start of the 10-day period cannot be established from the letter alone. No due date can be computed without knowing the receipt date.

warnings: The invoice shows no issue date, so the 10-day payment period ("innerhalb von 10 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung") cannot be computed exactly — the person should check the postmark/email date or envelope to establish the actual receipt date and count 10 days from the day after that.
